description: Zoho Cliq team chat with REST API, bots, webhooks and an official MCP server.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 via Zoho accounts (authorization code flow; implicit also declared); client registered in Zoho API Console with scopes like ZohoCliq.Channels.READ.
gate_detail: Developer registers a client in the Zoho API Console to get Client ID and secret; Cliq offers free signup and a 15-day trial. Whether the free plan includes API use is not stated.
api_scope: REST API v2/v3 for channels, chats, messages, bots, threads, reminders, scheduled messages, slash commands and more, with OpenAPI documents.
mcp_notes: Zoho-published Cliq MCP server; endpoint URL not stated in sources, only documentation pages.
blocker_detail: No approval or sales gate stated; OAuth client registration is self-serve.

evidence.quote: Zoho Cliq API uses the OAuth 2.0 protocol for authentication.
Once you register your client, you will get a Client ID and Client secret for your application.

uncertainties: Plan requirements for API use on the free tier are unclear.
MCP server endpoint URL is not given.
